name: cards
definition: 集换式卡牌游戏中的一张可被收集与使用的卡牌实体，具有名称、画家、颜色标识、法术力费用等属性。 Counterexample: 与「卡牌印刷版本」区分：卡牌是抽象的游戏牌面概念，印刷版本是某套牌在特定语言与套系下的具体发行物。 Maturity: Provisional
scope: Records of table cards; provenance: direct source cards

name: foreign_data
definition: 记录某张卡牌在非英文语言下的名称、文本与风味文本等本地化信息的信息记录。 Counterexample: 与「卡牌」区分：外文卡牌数据是卡牌的本地化描述信息，不是卡牌实体本身。 Maturity: Provisional
scope: Records of table foreign_data; provenance: direct source foreign_data

name: legalities
definition: 记录某张卡牌在特定比赛赛制下是否被允许使用的判定信息。 Counterexample: 与「卡牌」区分：赛制合法性是卡牌在规则层面的可用状态记录，不是卡牌实体。 Maturity: Provisional
scope: Records of table legalities; provenance: direct source legalities

name: rulings
definition: 官方针对某张卡牌规则疑问发布的解释性裁定记录，包含发布日期与裁定文本。 Counterexample: 与「赛制合法性」区分：裁定解释卡牌规则如何适用，赛制合法性说明卡牌能否在某赛制中使用。 Maturity: Provisional
scope: Records of table rulings; provenance: direct source rulings

name: set_translations
definition: 记录某套系代码在特定语言下对应名称的本地化翻译信息。 Counterexample: 与「套系」区分：套系翻译是套系名称的语言映射记录，不是套系本身。 Maturity: Provisional
scope: Records of table set_translations; provenance: direct source set_translations

name: sets
definition: 卡牌游戏按发行批次组织的一组卡牌的集合，具有代码、名称、发行日期与规模等属性。 Counterexample: 与「卡牌」区分：套系是卡牌的发行分组，卡牌是可被单独收集与使用的游戏牌面。 Maturity: Provisional
scope: Records of table sets; provenance: direct source sets

name: CardName
definition: The printed name of a Magic card.

name: Artist
definition: The illustrator credited on a card.

name: BorderColor
definition: The border color/style of a card (e.g. black, white, borderless).

name: Power
definition: The power value of a creature card; '*' or NULL denotes unknown/infinite.
scope: cards where power = '*' OR power IS NULL

name: IsPromo
definition: Flag indicating the card is a promotional printing.

name: IsTextless
definition: Flag indicating the card has no text box.

name: IsStorySpotlight
definition: Flag indicating the card is a Story Spotlight card.

name: FrameVersion
definition: The frame style/version of a card.

name: CardKingdomFoilId
definition: Card Kingdom foil product id; non-null paired with cardKingdomId indicates a powerful foil.
scope: cards where cardKingdomFoilId IS NOT NULL AND cardKingdomId IS NOT NULL

name: CardKingdomId
definition: Card Kingdom product id.
scope: cards where cardKingdomId IS NOT NULL

name: CardText
definition: The rules text of a card.

name: Colors
definition: The color(s) of a card (e.g. 'B' for black).

name: SetName
definition: The name of the card set.

name: SetCode
definition: The short code identifying a set.

name: BaseSetSize
definition: The number of cards in the base set.

name: IsForeignOnly
definition: Flag indicating the set is only available outside the United States.
aliases: only available outside the United States

name: SetTranslation
definition: The localized translation of a set name.
scope: set_translations where translation IS NOT NULL

name: Language
definition: The language of a card translation or set translation.

name: ForeignName
definition: The localized name of a card in a foreign language.

name: ForeignType
definition: The localized type line of a card in a foreign language.
scope: foreign_data where type IS NOT NULL

name: Format
definition: The game format a legality record refers to.

name: LegalityStatus
definition: The legality status of a card in a format.

name: RulingCount
definition: The number of rulings associated with a card.

name: PercentChineseSimplified
definition: Share of cards available in Chinese Simplified. Formula: COUNT(CardName WHERE Language = 'Chinese Simplified') / COUNT(CardName) * 100. Inputs: CardName = cards.name; Language = foreign_data.language WHERE language IN ('Italian','Chinese Simplified','German')
aliases: percentage of cards available in Chinese Simplified

name: PercentBorderless
definition: Share of cards with borderless border color. Formula: COUNT(CardName WHERE BorderColor = 'borderless') / COUNT(CardName) * 100. Inputs: CardName = cards.name; BorderColor = cards.borderColor

name: PercentStorySpotlightTextless
definition: Share of Story Spotlight cards that are textless. Formula: COUNT(CardName WHERE IsStorySpotlight = 1 AND IsTextless = 1) / COUNT(CardName WHERE IsStorySpotlight = 1) * 100. Inputs: CardName = cards.name; IsStorySpotlight = cards.isStorySpotlight WHERE isStorySpotlight = 1; IsTextless = cards.isTextless WHERE isTextless = 1
aliases: percentage of Story Spotlight cards without text box

name: PercentPowerfulFoilsInSet
definition: Share of cards in a set that have both Card Kingdom foil and non-foil ids. Formula: COUNT(CardName WHERE CardKingdomFoilId IS NOT NULL AND CardKingdomId IS NOT NULL) / COUNT(CardName) * 100. Inputs: CardName = cards.name; CardKingdomFoilId = cards.cardKingdomFoilId WHERE cardKingdomFoilId IS NOT NULL AND cardKingdomId IS NOT NULL; CardKingdomId = cards.cardKingdomId WHERE cardKingdomId IS NOT NULL
aliases: percentage of incredibly powerful cards in the set

name: MaxRulingCount
definition: Maximum number of rulings for any single card. Formula: MAX(RulingCount). Inputs: RulingCount = rulings.uuid

name: CountUnknownPower
definition: Number of cards with unknown or infinite power. Formula: COUNT(CardName WHERE Power = '*' OR Power IS NULL). Inputs: CardName = cards.name; Power = cards.power WHERE power = '*' OR power IS NULL
aliases: how many cards have infinite power

name: CountUnknownPowerTriggered
definition: Number of unknown-power cards whose text mentions triggered ability. Formula: COUNT(CardName WHERE (Power = '*' OR Power IS NULL) AND CardText LIKE '%triggered ability%'). Inputs: CardName = cards.name; Power = cards.power WHERE power = '*' OR power IS NULL; CardText = cards.text WHERE text LIKE '%triggered ability%'
aliases: unknown power cards with triggered ability info

name: CountItalianSmallSets
definition: Number of sets with Italian translation and base set size under 100. Formula: COUNT(SetName WHERE Language = 'Italian' AND BaseSetSize < 100). Inputs: SetName = sets.name; Language = foreign_data.language WHERE language IN ('Italian','Chinese Simplified','German'); BaseSetSize = sets.baseSetSize WHERE baseSetSize < 100
aliases: sets with Italian translation under 100 base size

name: CountForeignOnlySets
definition: Number of sets flagged as foreign-only. Formula: COUNT(SetName WHERE IsForeignOnly = 1). Inputs: SetName = sets.name; IsForeignOnly = sets.isForeignOnly WHERE isForeignOnly = 1

name: CountLegalCommander
definition: Number of cards legal in the commander format. Formula: COUNT(CardName WHERE Format = 'commander' AND LegalityStatus = 'Legal'). Inputs: CardName = cards.name; Format = legalities.format WHERE format = 'commander'; LegalityStatus = legalities.status WHERE status IN ('Legal','Banned')

name: CountBannedCards
definition: Number of cards with banned status. Formula: COUNT(CardName WHERE LegalityStatus = 'Banned'). Inputs: CardName = cards.name; LegalityStatus = legalities.status WHERE status IN ('Legal','Banned')

name: CountBlackArtifactsForeign
definition: Number of black artifact cards that have a foreign language translation. Formula: COUNT(CardName WHERE Colors = 'B' AND ForeignType IS NOT NULL). Inputs: CardName = cards.name; Colors = cards.colors WHERE colors = 'B'; ForeignType = foreign_data.type WHERE type IS NOT NULL
aliases: black artifact cards with foreign translation

name: CardLegality
definition: Which formats a card is legal or banned in.

name: CardLanguage
definition: Languages in which cards and sets are translated.

name: SetType
definition: The category of a card set.

name: CardLayout
definition: The physical layout style of a card.

name: FrameVersion
definition: The frame style version of a card.

name: BorderColor
definition: The border color of a card.

name: Rarity
definition: The rarity of a card.
